name: Comfort Intech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Comfort Intech Ltd trades in various goods and services and manufactures liquor[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CIL is a part of Comfort Group. It is in the business of trading goods including fans, fabrics, water heater and mono block pumps on the e-commerce platforms and  immediate suppliers of the marketplace platforms. Further, it manufactures & deals in spirits, including India Made Foreign, Country, Beverage and similar products

pros: Stock is trading at 1.13 times its book value
Debtor days have improved from 162 to 114 days.
Company's median sales growth is 27.5% of last 10 years
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 8.15% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 25.1% of their holding.
Dividend payout has been low at 11.8% of profits over last 3 years
